story: Swiss authorities confirmed the first cyber attacks that used AI agents, compromising systems at companies and at operators of critical infrastructure such as electricity and water suppliers.
South Africa welcomed more than one million international tourists in October, a rise of about 10 percent that puts the country on course to beat last year’s annual record.
Japan’s space agency unveiled a prototype rover, developed with India, that is designed to search for water near the Moon’s south pole before a planned launch in 2028.
The United States proposed new tariffs on goods from 14 major trading partners, including Switzerland, China and the European Union, citing excess industrial capacity.
At least 31 people were killed and 21 injured when a fuel tanker crashed and caught fire on a highway surrounding Cairo.
